name: Can under-cabinet lighting be added to an existing kitchen, or is it best for new remodels?

mainEntity.name: Can under-cabinet lighting be added to an existing kitchen, or is it best for new remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: While under-cabinet lighting can be added to an existing kitchen, integrating it during a full kitchen remodel offers the most seamless and aesthetically pleasing results. In a renovation, electrical wiring can be discreetly concealed within walls and cabinetry before finishes are installed, providing a clean, integrated look. Retrofitting into an existing kitchen might involve more visible wiring solutions or necessitate minor modifications to cabinetry to hide conduits. For homeowners seeking a cohesive transformation, incorporating it into the initial design phase of a customized renovation ensures optimal placement and functionality without compromising the overall aesthetic, reflecting our commitment to craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding under-cabinet lighting is best done during a full kitchen remodel for seamless integration and concealed wiring, though retrofitting an existing kitchen is possible with careful planning.
